tool_schemas.name: Hello Tool
tool_schemas.description: Returns a simple "hello" payload and records the tool invocation. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to invoke tools and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the tool-invocation limit is reached.

tool_schemas.name: Users Tool
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a list of users from the selected external provider (or requestUrl override), records the invocation, and returns a paged result set using cursor-based pagination (pass cursor to fetch the next page; limit controls page size) with optional sorting (sort/order). If useCache is enabled, we may return a previously cached response within cacheTtlSeconds unless refresh=true forces a fresh fetch; if invocationId is provided, the fetch is associated to that existing invocation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid parameter values (including an invalid invocationId format, unsupported provider, negative/zero limit, or malformed requestUrl), NOT_FOUND if invocationId is well-formed but does not exist, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if access is not allowed, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the external provider cannot be reached or returns an error.

useCache.description: Whether to use a cached users response when available

cacheTtlSeconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds to cache the users response

provider.description: Which external users provider to fetch from

requestUrl.description: Override URL to fetch users from (defaults to the provider's standard endpoint)

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for paginating the users list

sort.description: Field to sort returned users by

order.description: Sort order for the users list

refresh.description: If true, bypass cache and force a fresh fetch

invocationId.description: Optional existing tool invocation id to associate this fetch with

tool_schemas.name: Textract Tool
tool_schemas.description: Submits the specified filePath for AWS Textract analysis, records the invocation, and returns a Textract job tracker including current status and any extracted results when available (subsequent reads return updated status/results until completion or failure). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filePath is missing/empty or not a supported input, NOT_FOUND if the referenced path cannot be accessed, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if Textract submission is not permitted, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if submission/job limits are exceeded, and UPSTREAM_ERROR if AWS Textract rejects the request or the job transitions to a terminal error state.

filePath.description: The local path to the image file to be uploaded

tool_schemas.name: List Tool Invocations
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded tool invocations with optional filtering and cursor-based pagination. Returns a page of invocations and a nextCursor when more results exist. Refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to read invocation history.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for paginating through tool invocations

limit.description: Maximum number of invocations to return

createdAfter.description: Only return invocations created after this timestamp (inclusive)

createdBefore.description: Only return invocations created before this timestamp (exclusive)

invocationId.description: If provided, returns only this invocation id (equivalent to fetching one)

includeResponsePayload.description: When true, include response_payload in list items (may be large)

includeErrorDetails.description: When true, include error_code and error_message when present

tool_schemas.name: Get Tool Invocation
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single tool invocation by id, including timing fields, final status, and any response/error payload. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

tool_schemas.name: Update Tool Invocation Status
tool_schemas.description: Advances a tool invocation through its lifecycle and records runtime fields. Allows only declared forward transitions (received→running/failed, running→succeeded/failed). On succeeded, responsePayload must be provided and error fields must be null; on failed, errorMessage must be provided and responsePayload must be null. Sets finishedAt and durationMs when transitioning to a terminal state. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions or inconsistent payloads.

status.description: New status to set; must be a valid forward transition

startedAt.description: Start timestamp (required when moving to running if not already set)

finishedAt.description: Finish timestamp (required when moving to succeeded or failed)

durationMs.description: Duration in milliseconds; must match (finishedAt-startedAt) within tolerance when terminal

responsePayload.description: Tool response payload; required when status becomes succeeded; must be null when failed

errorCode.description: Machine-readable error code; allowed only when status becomes failed

errorMessage.description: Human-readable error message; required when status becomes failed; must be null when succeeded

tool_schemas.name: Get Textract Job
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a Textract job tracker by id, including current status and (optionally) attached results when available. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the job id does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

includeResults.description: When true, include any associated Textract results (if present)

includeRawResponse.description: When true, include raw Textract response payload in results (may be large)

tool_schemas.name: Update Textract Job Status
tool_schemas.description: Advances a Textract job through its lifecycle (queued→uploading→processing→succeeded, or any non-terminal state→failed) and records submission/completion metadata. Allows only declared forward transitions; once succeeded/failed the job is immutable except updatedAt and attaching results. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions or missing required fields for the new state.

status.description: New status to set; must be a valid forward transition

awsRequestId.description: AWS request id for the Textract submission (when available)

submittedAt.description: Timestamp when the job was submitted to AWS (set when entering processing)

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the job completed (required when entering succeeded or failed)

errorMessage.description: Error message; required when setting status to failed and must be null on succeeded
